text:
Looks like a small portion of scrambled eggs, roughly 1–2 eggs' worth. The plate is about 25 cm wide and the pile covers roughly 7×6 cm, about 2–3 cm thick at most. That works out to around 60 g of eggs. Scrambled eggs cooked with a little fat run about 150–170 kcal per 100 g, so 60 g gives roughly 95 kcal.
